headline: msnproduction: Claude Code skill for marketing
short_description: PT. MULIA SEJATI NUSANTARA Berdiri Pada Tanggal 24 Juni 2019 Sebuah Perseroan Terbatas yang bergerak di bidang jasa Suplier & Contractor.Kemudian pada 22 January 2022 PT. MULIA SEJATI NUSANTARA Membuka cabang usaha Baru di Bidang Teknologi yang meliputi Pembuatan Website, Apilkasi Mobile, Branding, Content Creative, Digital Marketing & Advertising.
author: berthutapea

sections.overview:
msnproduction is a marketing skill owned by berthutapea that represents PT. Mulia Sejati Nusantara, an Indonesian company established in June 2019 as a supplier and contractor services firm. In January 2022, the company expanded into technology services, offering website development, mobile applications, branding, creative content, digital marketing, and advertising solutions. This skill facilitates access to their technology-driven marketing and business services.
Website and mobile application development for business promotion
Digital marketing and advertising campaign management
Brand identity and creative content creation
Supplier and contractor service coordination
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/berthutapea/msnproduction`
sections.usage:
```
Act as a marketing consultant for PT. MULIA SEJATI NUSANTARA. Generate a 3-month digital marketing strategy to promote their new technology services including website development, mobile app creation, branding, content creation, and digital advertising. Focus on [INDUSTRY] and highlight how these services can benefit [TARGET_AUDIENCE]. Include specific tactics for each service and a budget breakdown.
```
